A.notes: Site A delivers a functional but very basic interpretation of the brief. The CSS illustrations are somewhat rudimentary, and the layout feels more like a standard template than an editorial experience. Motion is essentially non-existent beyond native scrolling.

B.notes: Site B captures the organic, editorial feel perfectly. The CSS/SVG illustrations use beautiful gradients to simulate the flame marks, and the typography is elegant and well-scaled. The scroll-driven animation where the hero cup pins and transitions into the featured product section adds a highly polished, purposeful touch.

raw.why: Site B elevates the brief with superior craft in its drawn imagery, elegant typography, and a purposeful scroll animation that connects the narrative.
